packages.label: פַּרְנָסָה וּמַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ
packages.reason: Parnasa (livelihood) and Maadanei Melekh (kingly delicacies) share the same essential identity: the divine sustenance channeled through the King is not merely food but a royal feast — it IS kingly delicacies in its essential nature. The Rebbe states this explicitly: 'הַפַּרְנָסָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ, כִּי מְקַבְּלִין אוֹתָהּ עַל יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ'. Parnasa received through the King is essentially royal, not mundane provision — both expressions point to the same divine bounty flowing through royalty.

packages.label: בֵּרוּרִים וּקְטֹרֶת
packages.reason: Birurim (spiritual clarifications/refinements) and Ketoret (incense) share the same essential nature: both are the process and result of extracting the holy from the shell. The Rebbe states explicitly: 'וְאֵלּוּ הַבֵּרוּרִים הֵם בְּחִינַת קְטֹרֶת, כַּיָּדוּעַ, שֶׁקְּטֹרֶת הִיא בְּחִינַת בֵּרוּרִים'. The incense offering was known to BE clarification — the burning that releases pure fragrance from physical matter is the same essential act as the spiritual clarification that extracts holy sparks from their material coating.

packages.label: הִתְחַבְּרוּת אִמְרֵי שֶׁפֶר עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְחֲתֻנָּה
packages.label_en: The Union of Beautiful Words with the King and Wedding
packages.reason: The joining of Imrei Shefer (beautiful words — blessings and prayers) with the King shares the same essential nature as Chatuna (wedding/sacred union). The Rebbe states: 'כִּי הִתְחַבְּרוּת שֶׁמִּתְחַבְּרִין הָאִמְרֵי שֶׁפֶר עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ, זֶה בְּחִינַת חֲתֻנָּה'. The joining of holy speech with royalty IS a wedding in its essential nature — the intimate bonding of two distinct domains into one is exactly what a wedding is. The verse 'חֵן שְׂפָתָיו רֵעֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ' confirms this: the grace of lips (Imrei Shefer) joins with the King as a companion/friend (reut), the intimacy of marriage.
